title: Irish Stew with Peas and Zesty Cornbread
description: A hearty and flavorful twist on traditional Irish stew, served with a side of zesty cornbread.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together cornmeal mix, eggs, and milk to form a batter.
Pour batter into a greased 8-inch square baking dish.
Bake cornbread for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
In a large pot or Dutch oven, cook sausage over medium-high heat, breaking up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add onion and garlic to pot and cook until onion is translucent.
Add carrots, potatoes, peas, and stew broth to pot.
Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
